headline: OpenAI expands ChatGPT desktop access with Linux launch
body: OpenAI released a ChatGPT desktop application for Linux, extending native client availability across operating systems while simultaneously losing its COO to resignation. For healthcare organizations, this expansion matters because it removes OS-specific friction from deploying AI assistants across diverse clinical workstations and IT infrastructures. Linux dominance in healthcare data centers and research environments means staff can now access standardized ChatGPT interfaces without browser dependencies, potentially improving clinical workflow integration. The parallel introduction of voice agent toolkits for React Native signals OpenAI's push toward embedded conversational AI in healthcare mobile applications, directly competing with vendors building EHR-native AI features.
